Lictor 0.2.0 is about installing it anywhere. Every release now ships ready-made packages for Debian/Ubuntu and Arch Linux, plus a static binary that runs on any x86_64 Linux. All of them include a man page and shell completions.

## Install

Pick the file for your system from the assets below.

| System | File | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Debian, Ubuntu and derivatives | `lictor_0.2.0-1_amd64.deb` | `sudo apt install ./lictor_0.2.0-1_amd64.deb` |
| Arch Linux and derivatives | `lictor-0.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | `sudo pacman -U lictor-0.2.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` |
| Any other x86_64 Linux | `lictor-0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz` | Extract it and copy `lictor` to your `PATH` ([details](https://syscallbrain.github.io/lictor/installation.html#any-other-distribution)) |

Check your download with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing`.

## What's new

- 📦 **Debian and Arch packages.** `apt` and `pacman` install `lictor` with its man page and completions, and remove it cleanly.
- 🐧 **Runs on any Linux.** The binary is now statically linked (musl), so it no longer depends on your system's glibc.
- 📖 **`man lictor`.** A full manual page with options, examples, selectors and exit codes.
- ⌨️ **Tab completion** for bash, zsh and fish, covering options and their values (`--status <Tab>` lists the agent states).
- 🔄 **Up-to-date dependencies:** crossterm 0.29 (now a single copy, shared with Ratatui), rand 0.10, base64 0.23 and toml 1.1.

## Fixes

- **The v0.1.0 binary did not start on Debian 12 or Ubuntu 22.04,** because it was built against glibc 2.39. The static binary in 0.2.0 has no glibc requirement.
- **Sidebar key discovery keeps working with toml 1.x.** Herdr's `config.toml` is now read as a full document (#7).

## For contributors

- Dependabot keeps crates and GitHub Actions up to date, and CodeRabbit reviews pull requests (#1).
- `scripts/dist.sh` builds every package locally, exactly as the release workflow does. The workflow installs and removes each package in Debian and Arch environments before publishing, and lints the Arch package with `namcap`.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/SyscallBrain/lictor/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0
